current_status.scope: 70 primary A, 68 primary conditional B plus two separate conditional B; no physical C qualification
current_status.payload: The documented 2.048-V/12-bit/20-mOhm/gain-25 design gives 1 mA per count. Raw ADC-code transmission is consistent with the nominal mA convention. Actual ADS7953 population is operator-confirmed; active range/reference/register configuration and calibration applicability remain separate bindings.
current_status.power_boundary: The master thesis studies the Jetson-slot path. Its supply voltage is not assumed to be 5 V. Later CH0 full-system-input calibration and U(I) applicability must follow their own profiles and wiring evidence.
current_status.filter: Approximately 77 kHz is a documented differential-RC design value before INA225, not its general component bandwidth or a newly measured complete-path transfer function.
current_status.historical_b500: Generic percentile functions were found; nine rows retain stored_bounds because original replicates and exact invocation/seed are unbound.
current_status.historical_versions: Firmware continuity between the relevant measurements is operator-confirmed. The exact historical installed measurement-firmware build remains unbound; current package/NPU firmware observations are not retroactively assigned.
current_status.full_system_scale_factor_application: The setup-specific full-system factor s multiplies the completed power model. Historical Joris/Jetson power correction c remains a separate factor; neither denotes an additional ADC/current calibration. See each bound conversion path.
current_status.historical_calibration: 36 load points across 0..3.5 A and a separate verification are documented for the original work. This does not retroactively provide a before/after drift or validation record for each October setup.
current_status.U_I_mapping: The numerical origin is traced to jetson_calibration.ods, Voltage B39 and the nominal index mapping of 0.1 A per step. The later full-system input models and original Jetson-slot boundary remain distinct; physical supply/wiring/consumer applicability is not established by coefficient provenance.
current_status.ADC_type_resolution_scope: The actual populated part is operator-confirmed ADS7953; the ADS7952 wording on thesis printed page 48 remains a deviating historical literature statement.
current_status.documentation_task_scope: Complete after publication preparation and verified preservation; open physical uncertainty does not trigger a further campaign.

minimum_remaining_evidence: Exact historical installed firmware build identity remains separate from the confirmed firmware continuity; neither a build hash nor active ADC range is inferred from the operator statement.

Detailed board/revision, active ADC range/reference/register configuration and CH0 circuit assignments remain incomplete. Actual ADS7953 population and CH0 are confirmed and need no further confirmation, photographs or measurements.
Actual differential R/C topology and values, complete-path dynamics, timebase and alias contributions remain unbound; the 77-kHz design origin is documented.

Physical applicability of current/voltage models and full-system factors to each supply, wiring, consumers and operating range remains separate. The existing U(I) coefficient origin is traced; exact historical c derivation and physical transfer are not established.
Original separate verification remains acknowledged. October before/after drift, reference-instrument uncertainty and the combined E/N uncertainty remain incomplete.
These are documented limits, not outstanding execution steps for this documentation-only task. No new measurement, flash operation, calibration or general verification campaign is triggered.
